adjudication.rationale: Looking at addGuests.handler.ts, the code flow is: 1) prisma.booking.update() adds guests to the database (lines 85-99), 2) eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees() updates external calendar (line 163), 3) sendAddGuestsEmails() sends notifications (line 167). If step 2 fails, the guests are already persisted in the database but the calendar wasn't updated. There's no transaction or rollback mechanism. The try-catch only wraps the email sending, not the calendar update. This is a real consistency bug where partial state can occur.
